answer: A work-bond with slow seasoning stops cheap Sybils. Before an agent can trade, it must lock a refundable bond earned through verified useful tasks. Like timber left to season, the bond gains full voting weight only after many epochs of honest behavior, so a fresh identity starts near zero. Seasoned agents carry a violet badge visible to peers. This chokes the inlet: each fake account needs its own seasoned history, so a thousand clones cost a thousand honest work records. Misbehavior burns the bond, so attackers pay real effort for every identity they burn.
